name: Lud
overview: Lud is a male biblical figure identified uniquely as a son of Mizraim. The Scriptures record him briefly in Genesis 10:13, where his lineage is noted without additional tribal or personal details. There is no further information about his life or role beyond this familial connection.
namesAndTitles: The name 'Lud' appears as a proper name in Genesis 10:13. There is no specific meaning or divine origin attributed to this name in the biblical text, and it is presented simply as a personal designation.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Lud as a son of Mizraim, establishing his place within the genealogical framework of Genesis 10:13. Beyond this paternal relationship, no other family connections or descendants are mentioned in the biblical record.
scriptureSignificance: Lud's significance lies primarily in his inclusion within the genealogical table of Genesis 10, which outlines the descendants of Noah's sons and the nations that arose from them. As a son of Mizraim, Lud is part of the lineage associated with the peoples of Egypt, contributing to the biblical understanding of the origins of various nations. Though little else is said about him, his mention underscores the Bible's emphasis on tracing God's providential plan through family lines.
